correctness.rationale: Headline finite-window claim re-verified from scratch. (1) Generator: gen231 implements standard Catalan decomposition pi=L n R with set(L)={1..k-1}, set(R)={k..n-1}; per-object avoids231 triple check passes on all 4862+16796 objects (soundness) and totals equal Catalan C9=4862, C10=16796 (completeness given known |Av_n(231)|=C_n). Independent brute-force cross-check via itertools+combinations pattern test re-run for n<=7 PASS (Catalan counts, LIS==Narayana, des+1==Narayana). (2) LIS: patience (bisect_left) vs RS first-row (bisect_right row insertion) asserted equal on every object at n=9,10; independent auditor re-run over all 4862+16796 objects confirms dual agreement, row sums, and equality to Narayana N(n,k)=C(n,k)C(n,k-1)/n. O(n^2) DP spot-check on 1000 random perms confirms patience implementation. (3) Dyck map D(pi)=U+D(Rstd)+D+D(L): standalone verify_bijection.py re-run n=1..10 PASS on all objects for structure lemma, Dyck validity, LIS==peaks, distinctness+count==Catalan (hence bijection onto Dyck_n in-window), histogram==Narayana, extremal uniqueness. (4) Extrema: identity is the unique perm of S_n with LIS=n and des=0, hence unique in Av_n(231); RS log on identity (no bumps, single row) is correct. Induction sketch for general n is honestly labeled conjecture, not claimed as proved. No boundary error: n=0 base, n=1..10 window, integer division exact. This is exhaustive finite proof for n=9,10, not asymptotic proof.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. Bare integers are classical Narayana (OEIS A001263 rows 9-10 match exactly) and draft explicitly disclaims novelty of the bare sequence. Novelty claimed is the LIS-keyed interpretation for Av(231) with dual per-object certificate and Dyck-peak transport at n=9,10. Nearest priors are disjoint: Deutsch-Hildebrand-Wilf math/0304126 gives only limiting LIS laws for length-3 classes (132 heights, 321 Erdos-Szekeres), not finite 231 histograms; Bona-DeJonge gives unique-LIS enumeration only; Mansour-Yildirim 1808.05430 gives averages for 312+tau, not single-pattern 231 histograms; Bukata et al. 1812.07112 gives ascents/descents/peaks/valleys (not LIS) over pattern classes; Hyatt-Remmel 1208.1052 and Kitaev-Zhang 2310.17236 prove the DESCENT distribution over 231/stack-sortable is Narayana (closest result) but descents do not mechanically imply LIS (no dihedral symmetry sends des to LIS: reverse/complement send LIS to LDS, inverse transposes RS shape); Zhuang 1610.07218 gives peak/descent joint laws over 231 (not LIS); Stump 0803.3706/0808.2822 bijections preserve maj/inv/major statistics (not LIS=peaks); Au-Bremner 2511.13671 bijects 231-avoiders to operator monomials/Dyck paths without LIS claim; OEIS A001263 records Dyck peaks and descents-over-132 (Zabrocki comment), not LIS-over-231; OEIS A000108 records only gross Catalan totals. Live arXiv all-fields searches for '231-avoiding permutations'+'longest increasing', 'stack-sortable'+'longest increasing subsequence', and Narayana+'longest increasing subsequence' each return no results, confirming the LIS-keyed 231 histogram is unrecorded under its natural description.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object, motivated before computation, not known or mechanically implied, and plausibly needed later. Object: Av_n(231)=stack-sortable perms (Knuth natural class, not ad hoc slice). Invariant: full LIS-length distribution (recognized frontier: Stanley survey program, Deutsch-Hildebrand-Wilf limits, Mansour-Yildirim averages, permuton LIS scaling). At n=9,10 the tables are the two largest lengths admitting exhaustive generation plus per-object tableau-log replay; they bridge gross Catalan counts and asymptotic regimes and serve as replayable RSK-shape/patience-sorting benchmarks plus citable finite anchor. Value does not rest on bare integers (classical) but on the new LIS-keying with dual patience/RS agreement, Catalan-total audit, Dyck-peak transport check, and unique extremal witnesses with insertion logs. No symmetry or published theorem mechanically yields LIS-from-descents or LIS-from-OEIS. General-n LIS=Narayana is honestly left as verified-to-10 conjecture, so the finite census is complete (not an incomplete census called complete) and its value does not require a general criterion or downstream theorem.

decisive_checks: Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_small.py: n=1..7 brute-force (itertools + combinations pattern test) PASS, Catalan counts and LIS==Narayana and des+1==Narayana.

Re-ran inputs/artifacts/verify_bijection.py standalone: n=1..10 PASS for decomposition value-sets, Dyck validity, LIS==peaks per object, image distinctness+count==Catalan, LIS hist==Narayana, des+1 hist==Narayana, unique max-LIS/min-des.

Independent auditor re-computation over all gen231(9)=4862 and gen231(10)=16796 objects: per-object avoids231 true, patience-pile LIS == RS-first-row length everywhere, totals==Catalan, histograms match draft and Narayana closed form.
Closed-form check: comb(n,k)*comb(n,k-1)//n reproduces both rows; row sums 4862 and 16796 verified.
O(n^2) DP LIS vs patience agreement on 1000 random perms; RS row-insertion (bisect_right bump) logic reviewed and consistent with distinct-value permutations.
residual_risks: Generator completeness argument depends on the classical theorem |Av_n(231)|=C_n (Knuth stack-sortability); soundness+count implies completeness only given that external enumeration.

Machine certificate trusts CPython stdlib (bisect, itertools, math.comb) and the auditor's independent pattern/LIS implementations; shared-specification bugs are mitigated by two independent LIS methods plus DP spot-check but not formally proved.
General-n LIS=Narayana remains a verified-to-10 conjecture; no general bijective proof is claimed or audited.

Literature search bounded to arXiv all-fields queries, OEIS, and cited papers; an obscure textbook exercise stating LIS-over-231=Narayana cannot be logically excluded, but natural-description searches and OEIS interpretation list show it is unrecorded where a future researcher would look.
Extremal uniqueness (identity) is mathematically trivial among all perms; its value is as a certified witness with replayable RS log, not as a deep theorem.
